sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: perform a control SAML login with <OneTimeUse/>, then replay the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) in a second login. Second attempt must be rejected if OneTimeUse and replay cache are enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (replay should be rejected).

sequence_description: Replay a previously accepted SAML assertion after revoking the session from the first login. Revocation should not disable SAML replay protection; the same assertion must still be rejected on reuse.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion after session revocation; replay protection may be incorrectly tied to session state.

sequence_description: SAML assertion replay without <OneTimeUse/>: reuse the exact same Assertion/@ID and assertion material twice; second attempt must be rejected by replay cache even if OneTimeUse is absent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted replayed SAML assertion with identical Assertion/@ID (replay cache not enforced)

sequence_description: Replay persistence across connector reconfiguration: accept a SAML assertion once, delete and recreate the connector, then replay the exact same assertion ID. Replay cache should not be reset by connector lifecycle changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_after_recreate_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_after_recreate_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted replayed SAML assertion after connector delete/recreate (replay cache reset enables reuse)

sequence_description: Test whether Dex incorrectly accepts an expired SAML assertion and/or allows replay of the exact same expired assertion ID across two SP-initiated flows (anti-replay + expiry enforcement). Includes a control valid login first to prove the connector/flow is correctly configured.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired1_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); expiry enforcement missing.

sequence_description: I5: Attempt to obtain an authenticated session from a SAML assertion with the entire <Conditions> element removed (no audience/time bounds). Control login uses a normal assertion. If Dex accepts the no-Conditions assertion, it may be granting permissions without upstream intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_control_login_status == true
Evaluation: user_control_login_status=200 == True → False
Implication: Control SAML login failed; cannot attribute subsequent acceptance/rejection to Conditions enforcement.

sequence_description: I5: Attempt to obtain an authenticated session from a SAML assertion with the entire <Conditions> element removed (no audience/time bounds). Control login uses a normal assertion. If Dex accepts the no-Conditions assertion, it may be granting permissions without upstream intent constraints.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status == false
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 == False → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion with no <Conditions>, enabling permissions without upstream audience/time intent.

sequence_description: I5: Configure SAML connector to gate authentication on membership in an allowed group and filter emitted groups. Then attempt to authenticate as a user with no allowed group but with other groups, to see if Dex mistakenly grants a session/policies anyway (authz binding failure). Includes re-auth after config change.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_disallowedgroup_login_status == false
Evaluation: user_attacker_disallowedgroup_login_status=200 == False → False
Implication: Dex granted a session to a user lacking any allowedGroups membership, violating authorization binding (permissions granted without upstream group intent).

sequence_description: I5 attack: attempt to bypass group-based authorization binding by confusing Dex's SAML groups parsing. Configure connector to require allowedGroups=['admins'] and set a nonstandard groups_delim. Then authenticate an attacker whose assertion carries a single groups attribute value that could be mis-parsed into including 'admins' (e.g., 'devs;admins') even though upstream intent is not true membership. Secure behavior: login rejected (or at least no 'admins' group emitted).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_composite_group_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_composite_group_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML login where the only asserted group value was a composite string ('devs;admins'); this suggests group parsing confusion bypassed allowedGroups gating, granting authorization beyond upstream intent.
